name: Toronto
living: the CN-style tower's pink and blue light shafts slowly cycle colours, its pod ring twinkling
a red aircraft-warning light blinks slowly at the tower's tip and on the twin-antenna skyscraper
the dome's arch of blue-white light breathes softly
the lake shimmers with rippling reflections of the city lights
skyscraper windows flicker on and off across downtown
stars twinkle in the clear night sky, and now and then a plane crosses with blinking lights
the video board's skyline graphic pulses and the scoreboard updates after a home run
light-tower lamp banks glow and breathe, moths drifting through their cones
the red-white-blue bunting on the stands ripples in the lake breeze
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
